title: Data science: wrangling, exploration and visualization
stage: College AI and machine learning degree
audience: a college student in an artificial intelligence, machine learning or computer science degree program, or an adult studying the same material on their own
purpose: Work with data from start to finish in Python: reading CSV and JSON data, cleaning missing and inconsistent values, filtering, grouping, joining and reshaping tables, summary statistics and distributions, exploratory analysis, choosing and describing charts, feature engineering, sampling bias and data leakage, documenting data sets, and handling personal data responsibly.
primary_reading: Computational and Inferential Thinking: The Foundations of Data Science (free online)

weeks.1: The data science workflow and tabular data
weeks.2: Reading CSV and JSON files into Python structures
weeks.3: Cleaning data: missing values, types and inconsistencies
weeks.9: Feature engineering: scaling, encoding and derived features
weeks.10: Sampling bias, data leakage and train-test contamination
weeks.11: Documenting data: datasheets and data dictionaries
weeks.12: Privacy and the responsible use of personal data

blocks.deliverable: Load three small data files and report their shape and types.
Clean a messy table with reusable functions.
Join two tables and summarize a variable by group.
Week 7 midterm; describe the charts you would make for a data set and why.
Engineer features for a prediction task and check for leakage.
Write a datasheet for a data set you cleaned.
Submit the project; take an unseen 120 minute final in week 14.

project: Data analysis report: take a supplied raw data set, clean it with documented functions, explore it with summary tables and charts you make with any plotting tool on your own computer, engineer features for one prediction question, and write a report with a data dictionary, a datasheet, the main findings and the limitations of the data.
completion: finish the project, take the week 7 midterm and week 14 cumulative final, then complete a new cumulative assessment after 1 to 2 weeks. Explain one major idea aloud without notes.
